Asobi 1.0 (build 1196) Oct 3, 2026

  • Showcases on iPhone and iPad: a showcase's sound now travels inside the picture, so it stays in sync on every device, through scrubs and full screen. On an iPhone, a one-clip showcase goes truly full screen. Remake a showcase to get it.
  • Skip sign-in on by default: new showcases let viewers skip the name and email card. Turn it off in Make Showcase if you want every visitor signed in.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1178) Oct 3, 2026

  • Save on quit works again: choosing Save when Asobi asks about unsaved changes now saves and quits (or relaunches after an update). A session with a note attachment used to read as unsaved right after saving, so the quit was cancelled, and a session you had just saved asked again.
  • Quiet jumps: clicking a note, its timecode or a marker no longer plays a repeating snatch of sound. Only dragging the playhead plays audio while stopped.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1174) Oct 3, 2026

  • Reports, redesigned: the notes report and the review activity report now use Asobi’s own design, like the manual: numbered entries, the notes in a readable serif with a byline each, replies under their notes, and nothing split across a page.
  • Spell check in comments: notes and replies get the Mac’s red underline, with right-click suggestions. Autocorrect is there too if you want it: Settings ▸ Notes or Edit ▸ Spelling in Comments.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1170) Oct 3, 2026

  • Timeline markers: notes show as a blue line, markup as an amber triangle on the top edge, like a mark in an edit application. A frame with both shows both.
  • Replies: a Send button appears beside a reply as you type (Return still sends).
  • Note report: replies print under their notes, the comment text is larger, and small markup is shown magnified with the whole frame as an inset that stays clear of the marks.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1165) Oct 2, 2026

  • Menus during playback: the menu bar’s menus and submenus stay put and take clicks while a clip plays.
  • Aspect ratio bars in exports: the QuickTime export’s Burn in options can add black bars outside the tightest guide on screen, with or without the frame lines and labels.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1162) Oct 2, 2026

  • Steadier while playing: menus no longer flicker or miss clicks during playback, and the toolbar keeps its width.
  • Volume: the Sound button opens a vertical volume slider with mute at the bottom (M still mutes).
  • Aspect guides: add your own ratio with Custom Ratio… (2.2, 2.20:1, 4:5 or 1920x800) — web reviewers see it too. The mask is now three simple choices: No Mask, Dim Outside, Hard Mask.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1157) Oct 2, 2026

  • Frame lines: View ▸ Aspect Guides now has Lines (on or off) and Mask (None, Dim Outside, Hard Mask) — so a mask can show on its own. Something always shows while guides are on.
  • Kitsu: the status choices load as soon as you sign in.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1153) Oct 2, 2026

  • Frame lines: View ▸ Aspect Guides ▸ Style draws them as lines, dims everything outside the frame, or masks it to black. Web reviewers now see your frame lines too, and can pick their own style.
  • Volume: the arrow beside the Sound button opens a volume slider.
  • Find Originals is smarter: it uses each Kitsu clip’s comment path whatever folder you point it at, matches Kitsu’s own clip names, and searches inside any folder you choose. Source Links remembers its folder.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
